not_found.name: Unknown
description: ## Error
Unable to find the requested rage power.

animal_fury.name: Animal Fury
description: ::ab{title="&L&Animal Fury (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a ‹umr/bite attack›. If used as part of a full attack action, the bite attack is made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus -5. If the bite hits, it deals 1d4 points of damage (assuming the barbarian is Medium; 1d3 points of damage if Small) plus half the barbarian's Strength modifier." special="A barbarian can make a bite attack as part of the action to maintain or break free from a grapple. This attack is resolved before the grapple check is made. If the bite attack hits, any grapple checks made by the barbarian against the target this round are at a +2 bonus."}

greater_animal_fury.name: Greater Animal Fury
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Greater Animal Fury (Ex)&FN&" ability="This power works as *animal fury,* but the barbarian's bite attack deals damage as if she were ‹misc/one size category larger›." prereq="‹ragepower/Animal fury›"}

bloody_bite.name: Bloody Bite
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Bloody Bite (Ex)&FN&" prereq="‹race/Half-orc›, either ‹ragepower/animal fury› or a natural bite attack" passive="The barbarian's bite attack deals 1d6 points of ‹rule/bleed› damage in addition to its other effects."}

feasting_bite.name: Feasting Bite
description: ::ab{icon=aid title="&L&Feasting Bite (Ex)&FN&" prereq="‹race/Half-orc›, ‹ragepower/bloody bite›, either ‹ragepower/animal fury› or a natural bite attack" passive="When the barbarian confirms a critical hit with her bite attack, she regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Activating this ability consumes 1 round of *rage.*"}

penetrating_bite.name: Penetrating Bite
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Penetrating Bite (Ex)&FN&" prereq="4th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/animal fury›" flavor="When using the *animal fury* rage power while *raging,* the barbarian's bite is able to pierce most resistances." l4="Her bite is treated as a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." l7="Her bite is also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." l10="Her bite is also treated as a chaotic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." l16="Her bite is treated as an ‹eq-material/adamantine› weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness."}

savage_jaw.name: Savage Jaw
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Savage Jaw (Ex)&FN&" flavor="While *raging,* the barbarian can open her jaw wide and latch her teeth firmly onto her opponent." free="While using the *animal fury* power, the barbarian can activate this power and gain the ‹umr/grab› ability with her bite attack until the start of her next turn." usage="Once per *rage*" prereq="‹ragepower/Animal fury›"}

vipers_kiss.name: Viper's Kiss
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Viper's Kiss (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian can drink 1 dose of an ingested poison as a @HLmove_action (instead of a standard action) as long as she starts the turn with the poison in her hand. She can hold this dose within her mouth for a number of rounds equal to her Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round) without suffering harmful effects. If the barbarian still holds the poison in her mouth after this time, she consumes the poison.~~~While the dose is held within her mouth, the barbarian's next successful bite attack applies the effect of the poison with an immediate onset; this consumes the dose." prereq="‹ragepower/Animal fury› or a has bite attack while *raging*"}

vipers_breath.name: Viper's Breath
description: ::ab{icon=cone title="&L&Viper's Breath (Ex)&FN&" ability="While holding a dose of poison in her mouth, the barbarian can exhale a 15-foot cone of inhaled poison. Anyone caught in the spray must succeed at a saving throw against the poison with a DC equal to the poison's DC - 4 or suffer the poison's effects with an immediate onset." prereq="‹ragepower/Viper's kiss›"}

enhance_venom.name: Enhance Venom
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Enhance Venom (Ex)&FN&" passive="The barbarian adds her Constitution modifier to the DC of any poison she delivers using *viper's kiss* or *viper's breath.*" prereq="‹ragepower/Viper's kiss›, ‹ragepower/viper's breath›"}

armor_ripper.name: Armor Ripper
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Armor Ripper&FN&" passive="While *raging,* you gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to ‹rule/sunder› with any of your natural attacks." prereq="‹race/Wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

auspicious_mark.name: Auspicious Mark
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Auspicious Mark (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian has been marked by the spirits, as indicated by an impressive tattoo, scar, or birthmark she possesses." usage="Once per *rage*" swift="By spending 2 rounds of *rage,* the barbarian can call upon the spirits' favor. Using *auspicious mark* grants her a +1d6 bonus on one d20 roll she has just made." special="She can call on the *auspicious* mark after seeing the result of the d20 roll."}

autumn_rage.name: Autumn Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Autumn Rage (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian becomes a servant of the harvest." passive="While *raging,* she gains a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to ‹rule/reposition› or ‹rule/trip›. She also gains this bonus on attack rolls to confirm critical hits." special="A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between ‹ragepower/spring<_rage›, ‹ragepower/summer<_rage›, *autumn,* or ‹ragepower/winter<_rage› rage."}

bloody_fist.name: Bloody Fist
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Bloody Fist (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian may attempt to punch through an opponent's flesh and rip out one of its vital organs. In order to do so, the barbarian must confirm a critical hit against an opponent with a natural attack or unarmed strike. The barbarian deals damage as normal for a critical hit and the opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's class level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or take 1d4 points of ‹rule/Constitution damage› as one of its vital organs is ripped free from its body." usage="Once per *rage*" prereq="12th-level barbarian"}

feast_of_blood.name: Feast of Blood
description: ::ab{icon=aid-def title="&L&Feast of Blood (Su)&FN&" flavor="While *raging,* the barbarian may feast on the organs of her foes and absorb their power." provokes fullround="After successfully ripping out a creature's vital organ, the barbarian may eat the organ within 1 minute of extracting it. Once the organ is consumed, the barbarian recovers a number of hit points equal to the Hit Dice of the organ's owner.~~~In addition, the barbarian gains any energy immunities or resistances the victim had, though the effectiveness of these resistances is halved (for instance, a barbarian who eats the heart of a creature with ‹umr/resist› cold 10 would gain resist cold 5; energy immunities are reduced to resist energy 20). This energy resistance lasts for a number of rounds equal to half the Hit Dice of the creature whose organ was consumed." prereq="‹ragepower/Bloody fist›, 14th-level barbarian"}

boars_charge.name: Boar's Charge
description: ::ab{icon=melee-boost title="&L&Boar's Charge&FN&" ability="While *raging,* when you hit with a gore attack as part of a ‹rule/charge›, you automatically score a critical threat. You must still confirm the critical hit as normal." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹race/wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

boasting_taunt.name: Boasting Taunt
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Boasting Taunt (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can incite a creature to attack her by making an ‹skill/Intimidate› check to demoralize. If the check succeeds, the target is also ‹misc/shaken› as long as the barbarian is visible and *raging* or until it makes a melee attack against the barbarian. The barbarian receives a +2 circumstance bonus on this check for every alcoholic drink she has consumed during this *rage.*" special="This is a language-dependent mind-affecting effect, and it relies on audible components." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

body_bludgeon.name: Body Bludgeon
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Body Bludgeon (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* if the barbarian ‹rule/pin«s› an opponent that is smaller than her, she can then use that opponent as a two-handed ‹misc/improvised weapon› that deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage, assuming the opponent is sized Small. Larger or smaller creatures used as a bludgeon deal damage based on their size using this base damage. A size Tiny creature deals 1d6 points of damage, a size Medium creature deals 1d10 points of damage, ‹misc/and so on›.~~~The barbarian can make a single attack using the pinned opponent as part of the action she uses to maintain the grapple, using her highest attack bonus. Whenever the barbarian hits using the pinned opponent as a weapon, she deals damage to her target normally, and the grappled opponent used as a bludgeon also takes the same damage she dealt to the target." special="If the pinned opponent is unable to resist being pinned for any reason, the barbarian can use that opponent as an improvised weapon without grappling or pinning the opponent, until the creature is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, at which point the creature becomes useless as an improvised weapon." prereq="10th-level barbarian"}

brawler.name: Brawler
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Brawler&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian is treated as if she has ‹feat/Improved Unarmed Strike›. If she already has the feat, her unarmed strikes deal 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if she is Small)."}

greater_brawler.name: Greater Brawler
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Greater Brawler&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian is treated as if she has ‹feat/Two-Weapon Fighting› when making unarmed strike attacks." prereq="‹ragepower/Brawler›"}

breathtaker.name: Breathtaker
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Breathtaker (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian's blows take the air from her foes' lungs." ability="While *raging,* whenever the barbarian makes a successful melee attack against an opponent that is ‹misc/hold«ing» its breath›, in addition to any other effects caused by that attack, the opponent loses a number of rounds of breath equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier."}

clear_mind.name: Clear Mind
description: ::ab{icon=def-roll title="&L&Clear Mind (Ex)&FN&" immediate="A barbarian may reroll a failed Will save. This power is used after the first save is attempted, but before the results are revealed by the GM. The barbarian must take the second result, even if it is worse." prereq="8th-level barbarian" special="This power can only be used once per *rage.*"}

come_and_get_me.name: Come and Get Me
description: ::ab{icon=down-melee title="&L&Come and Get Me (Ex)&FN&" free="While *raging,* the barbarian may leave herself open to attack while preparing devastating counterattacks. Enemies gain a +4 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the barbarian until the beginning of her next turn, but every attack against the barbarian provokes an attack of opportunity from her, which is resolved prior to resolving each enemy attack." prereq="12th-level barbarian"}

contagious_rage.name: Contagious Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Contagious Rage (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian howls during combat, agitating nearby fauna." ability="Willing animals and magical beasts within 30 feet of the barbarian gain the benefits of the ‹spell/rage› spell for as long as she maintains her *rage.* After the barbarian's *rage* ends, creatures affected by her *rage* are ‹misc/fatigued› for the same number of rounds as the barbarian." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

deathless_frenzy.name: Deathless Frenzy
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Deathless Frenzy&FN&" passive="While *raging,* you ignore the effects of being at 0 or fewer hit points until you have been at 0 or fewer hit points for 1 round, at which point the appropriate consequences for your current hit point total take effect. Even death can be postponed this way, potentially allowing you to survive if you receive sufficient healing before the round is up." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹race/wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

disemboweling_tusks.name: Disemboweling Tusks
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Disemboweling Tusks&FN&" ability="While *raging,* when you confirm a critical hit with your gore attack, you deal 1d4 points of ‹rule/Constitution damage› in addition to the normal damage for the gore attack." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹race/wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

dissipating_rage.name: Dissipating Rage
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Dissipating Rage (Su)&FN&" passive="When the barbarian *rages,* her feverish frenzy and hot breath burn or blow fog, smoke and similar effects away from her. The barbarian and creatures adjacent to her do not gain ‹rule/concealment› from obfuscating effects like fog or precipitation." special="Magical effects that require more than a strong wind to dissipate are not affected by this rage power."}

eclipsing_rage.name: Eclipsing Rage
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Eclipsing Rage (Su)&FN&" passive="While the barbarian is *raging,* the ‹rule/light level› within 10 feet of her lowers by one step. She can't decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability." special="Multiple barbarians with this rage power don't further reduce the light level." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

greater_eclipsing_rage.name: Greater Eclipsing Rage
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Greater Eclipsing Rage (Su)&FN&" passive="Whenever the barbarian *rages,* the ‹rule/light level› within 20 feet of her lowers by two steps instead of one. She still can't decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/eclipsing rage›"}

lesser_elemental_rage.name: Lesser Elemental Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Lesser Elemental Rage (Su)&FN&" swift="The barbarian can cause her melee attacks to deal an additional 1d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) for 1 round." prereq="4th-level barbarian" usage="Once per *rage*"}

elemental_rage.name: Elemental Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Elemental Rage (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* all of the barbarian's melee attacks deal an additional 1d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). The type is chosen when the barbarian begins her *rage.*" prereq="8th-level barbarian,‹ragepower/lesser elemental rage›" special="The barbarian can still use her *lesser elemental rage* power while using this rage power, but she must select a different energy type."}

greater_elemental_rage.name: Greater Elemental Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Greater Elemental Rage (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* all of the barbarian's critical hits made with melee weapons deal an additional 1d10 points of energy damage (2d10 if the weapon deals &times&3 damage on a critical hit, 3d10 if the weapon deals &times&4 on a critical hit). The type of this damage is the same as the type chosen for the *elemental rage* power." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/elemental rage›"}

energy_resistance.name: Energy Resistance
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Energy Resistance (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains ‹umr/resistance› to one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) equal to 1/2 her barbarian level (minimum 1)." special="The energy type is chosen when this rage power is selected and it cannot be changed. This rage power can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time is applies to a different energy type."}

greater_energy_resistance.name: Greater Energy Resistance
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Greater Energy Resistance (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* a barbarian can reduce damage by half from a single attack against which she has energy resistance (halve the damage, then apply resistance)." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/energy resistance›"}

energy_absorption.name: Energy Absorption
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Energy Absorption (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can absorb energy from a single attack of her chosen energy type once per *rage.* She does not make a saving throw against the effect but takes no damage from it, instead gaining 1 temporary hit point per 3 points of damage the attack would have inflicted. These ‹rule/temporary hit points› last until the end of the barbarian's *rage.*" prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/greater energy resistance›"}

energy_eruption.name: Energy Eruption
description: ::ab{icon=def-line-cone title="&L&Energy Eruption (Su)&FN&" usage="Once per *rage*" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can absorb energy from a single attack and unleash it upon her enemies. She does not make a saving throw against the effect but takes no damage from it.~~~At any point during the remainder of her *rage* she can unleash the stored energy as a breath weapon in either a 60-foot line or 30-foot cone. The breath weapon inflicts damage equal to the damage from the attack absorbed by the barbarian, but creatures within the area may make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier) for half damage even if the original effect did not allow a save." prereq="16th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/energy absorption›"}

erratic_charge.name: Erratic Charge
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Erratic Charge (Ex)&FN&" ability="As part of the full-round action to perform a ‹rule/charge› attack against a creature at least 20 feet away, the barbarian can move 5 feet in any direction before making the charge. This movement is not a 5-foot step and provokes attacks of opportunity as normal, and using this option reduces the maximum distance of the charge by 10 feet."}

greater_erratic_charge.name: Greater Erratic Charge
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Greater Erratic Charge (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian can move 10 feet when using *erratic charge.* If she does so, the creature she is charging must be at least 20 feet away and the movement reduces the maximum distance of her charge by 20 feet." prereq="‹ragepower/Erratic charge›"}

fearless_rage.name: Fearless Rage
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Fearless Rage (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian is immune to the ‹misc/shaken› and ‹misc/frightened› conditions." prereq="12th-level barbarian"}

ferocious_beast.name: Ferocious Beast
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Ferocious Beast (Ex)&FN&" passive="While the barbarian is *raging,* her animal companion also gains the benefits of *rage* (including *greater rage, mighty rage,* and *tireless rage*), though the barbarian must spend 1 additional round of *rage* per round if her companion begins or ends its turn adjacent to her, and 2 additional rounds of *rage* per round if not."}

greater_ferocious_beast.name: Greater Ferocious Beast
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Greater Ferocious Beast (Ex)&FN&" passive="While the barbarian is *raging,* her animal companion shares the benefits of the barbarian's rage powers that are constant in effect. It gains no benefit from rage powers that require actions to activate, even if they are free actions." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ferocious beast›"}

ferocious_mount.name: Ferocious Mount
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Ferocious Mount (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging* and mounted, the barbarian's mount also gains the benefits of *rage* (including *greater rage* and *mighty rage*) as long as the barbarian is mounted or adjacent to it. While her mount is *raging* in this way, she must spend one additional round of *rage* per round. She can elect not to pay this cost, in which case her mount does not *rage.*"}

greater_ferocious_mount.name: Greater Ferocious Mount
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Greater Ferocious Mount (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging* and mounted, the barbarian's mount gains the benefits of any rage powers that are constant in effect when the barbarian is *raging.* It does not gain the benefit of any rage powers that require actions to activate, even if they are free actions." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ferocious mount›"}

ferocious_trample.name: Ferocious Trample
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Ferocious Trample (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging* and mounted, the barbarian's mount gains the ‹umr/trample› special attack. This attack inflicts 1d8 points of damage for a Medium mount, 2d6 for a Large mount, or 2d8 for a Huge mount, plus 1-1/2 times the mount's Strength modifier. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the mount's Strength modifier) halves this damage.~~~Creatures in the mount's path or that threaten squares it passes through may make attacks of opportunity against either the barbarian or the mount, but not both." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ferocious mount›"}

greater_ferocious_trample.name: Greater Ferocious Trample
description: ::ab{icon=boost-melee title="&L&Greater Ferocious Trample (Ex)&FN&" ability="A barbarian's mount can affect creatures up to its own size with its *ferocious trample.* In addition, it can make an ‹rule/overrun› combat maneuver check as a @HLfree_action against a creature that fails its Reflex save (or chooses not to save in order to take an attack of opportunity) against its trample." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ferocious trample›"}

spirit_steed.name: Spirit Steed
description: ::ab{icon=def-boost title="&L&Spirit Steed (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging* and mounted, the barbarian's mount gains DR/magic equal to 1/2 the barbarian's level. The mount's natural weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ferocious mount›"}

fierce_fortitude.name: Fierce Fortitude
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Fierce Fortitude (Ex)&FN&" passive="The character gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against diseases and poison." prereq="Trained in ‹skill/Intimidate›"}

flesh_wound.name: Flesh Wound
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Flesh Wound (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* the barbarian can try to avoid serious harm from an attack. The barbarian must make a Fortitude save with a DC equal to the damage that would be dealt by the attack. The barbarian's armor check penalty applies on this saving throw. If the save succeeds, the barbarian takes half damage from the attack and the damage is nonlethal." special="The barbarian must elect to use this ability after the attack roll is made, but before the damage is rolled." prereq="10th-level barbarian"}

flight_response.name: Flight Response
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Flight Response&FN&" immediate="When a barbarian attempts a saving throw against a fear effect, she can enter a *rage* (as long as she would normally be able to enter *rage*). This consumes 3 rounds of the barbarian's daily allotment of *rage* rounds, but the barbarian can maintain the *rage* each round on her turn normally. Any benefits from the barbarian's *rage* apply immediately, so she gains her bonus on Will saves against the effect that required the initial saving throw." special="Unlike most rage powers, this rage power's effects are useful only when the barbarian is not *raging,* so a skald can't grant this rage power to allies with raging song."}

fueled_by_vengeance.name: Fueled by Vengeance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Fueled by Vengeance&FN&" ability="While *raging,* whenever you deal weapon damage to a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn, add 1 round to your remaining number of rounds of *rage* for the current day." special="You can gain no more than 1 extra round of *rage* each round." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹race/wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

furious_draw.name: Furious Draw
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Furious Draw&FN&" ability="The barbarian is treated as having the ‹feat/Quick Draw› feat."}

furious_barrage.name: Furious Barrage
description: ::ab{icon=power-ranged title="&L&Furious Barrage (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian is treated as having the ‹feat/Rapid Shot› feat, but only for the purpose of attacking with thrown weapons. She need not meet the feat's prerequisites." prereq="4th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/furious draw›"}

ghost_rager.name: Ghost Rager
description: ::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Ghost Rager (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian deals normal damage to incorporeal creatures even when using nonmagical weapons. She also gains a morale bonus to touch AC equal to 2 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level. This can't raise her touch AC above her full AC." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

good_for_what_ails_you.name: Good for What Ails You
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Good for What Ails You (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian who takes a drink of alcohol may attempt a new saving throw against one of the following conditions that may be affecting her: blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, exhausted, fatigued, frightened, nauseated, panicked, shaken, or sickened. If she succeeds at the save, the effect is suppressed for the duration of the *rage.*" special="She also may attempt a new saving throw if poisoned; a successful save counts against those required for a cure, but a failed save has no ill effect."}

ground_breaker.name: Ground Breaker
description: ::ab{icon=melee-lower title="&L&Ground Breaker (Ex)&FN&" usage="Once per *rage*" standard="The barbarian can attack the floor around her. This attack automatically hits and deals damage normally. If the barbarian manages to deal more damage than the floor's hardness, the space she occupies and all of the squares adjacent to her become ‹rule/difficult terrain›. Creatures in these squares, except the barbarian, must make a DC 15 Reflex save or be knocked ‹rule/prone›." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

greater_ground_breaker.name: Greater Ground Breaker
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Greater Ground Breaker (Ex)&FN&" ability="When using the *ground breaker* rage power, the barbarian can extend the radius of the effect by 5 feet." special="This rage power can be selected up to three times, and its effects stack." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/ground breaker›"}

guarded_life.name: Guarded Life
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Guarded Life (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* if the barbarian is reduced below 0 hit points, 1 hit point of lethal damage per barbarian level is converted to nonlethal damage. If the barbarian is at negative hit points due to lethal damage, she immediately ‹misc/stabilize«s›."}

greater_guarded_life.name: Greater Guarded Life
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Greater Guarded Life (Ex)&FN&" passive="When using the *guarded life* rage power, 1 additional hit point of lethal damage per barbarian level is converted to nonlethal damage." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/guarded life›"}

guarded_stance.name: Guarded Stance
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Guarded Stance (Ex)&FN&" move="The barbarian gains a dodge bonus to her Armor Class against melee attacks for a number of rounds equal to the barbarian's current Constitution modifier (minimum 1). This dodge bonus is equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-sixth› her barbarian level." provokes=No}

hissing_rage.name: Hissing Rage
description: :::ab{icon=touch title="&L&Hissing Rage (Su)&FN&" usage="Once per hour" action="Standard Action"}

Once per hour, the barbarian can spit venom at an adjacent enemy. She must make a touch attack to successfully spit on a foe in this way, but she can also apply this poison as a @HL[swift action] when she hits with a bite attack.
::aff[Hissing Rage Poison]{iconP type="Bite-contact or injury" freqR=6 dcF dcLev=barbarian dcIt=her dcMod=Con effStr="1d2" cure2c}

lesser_hurling.name: Lesser Hurling
description: ::ab{icon=zap title="&L&Lesser Hurling (Ex)&FN&" fullround="While *raging,* the barbarian can lift and hurl an object up to one size category smaller than herself with both hands or two size categories smaller with one hand as an ‹misc/improvised weapon› with a range increment of 10 feet. This inflicts damage as a ‹rule/falling object<s› plus the barbarian's Strength bonus. This damage is halved if the object is not made of stone, metal, or similar material." special="This is a ranged touch attack, and the target may attempt a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) for half damage. The barbarian may apply ‹feat/Power Attack› to this attack as a one- or two-handed weapon, as appropriate."}

hurling.name: Hurling
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Hurling (Ex)&FN&" ability="As *lesser hurling,* but the barbarian can increase the range increment to 20 feet or increase the size of a hurled object by one size category." prereq="‹ragepower/Lesser hurling›, 8th-level barbarian"}

greater_hurling.name: Greater Hurling
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Greater Hurling (Ex)&FN&" ability="As *hurling,* but the barbarian can increase the range increment to 30 feet or increase the size of a hurled object by two size categories." prereq="‹ragepower/Hurling›, 12th-level barbarian"}

hurling_charge.name: Hurling Charge
description: ::ab{icon=zap title="&L&Hurling Charge (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging* and making a ‹rule/charge› attack, the barbarian may draw and throw a *hurled* weapon during her charge, gaining the normal +2 attack roll bonus on the thrown weapon attack as well as on the melee attack at the end of the charge." special="The barbarian must move at least 10 feet before using a thrown weapon and at least 10 additional feet before making a melee attack at the end of her charge. The barbarian must have a thrown weapon in hand or have one hand free at the beginning of her charge." prereq="‹ragepower/Lesser hurling›, 6th-level barbarian"}

impelling_disarm.name: Impelling Disarm
description: ::ab{icon=melee-ranged title="&L&Impelling Disarm (Ex)&FN&" usage="Once per *rage*" ability="The barbarian can make a ‹rule/disarm› attempt against a target in place of a melee attack. This attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity.~~~If successful, the barbarian sends the target's weapon flying - either straight at the target, or spinning away to strike another foe up to 20 feet away. This ranged attack has a -4 penalty, as it is treated as ‹rule/throwing a »weapon« that i»s«n't designed to be thrown›, even if the weapon disarmed is a thrown weapon.~~~The barbarian makes a ranged attack, which doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity, at either the target of his disarm maneuver or another creature within 20 feet. If the barbarian is aiming for the disarmed creature, the foe doesn't count as being in melee for determining any penalty on the ranged attack from throwing a ranged weapon into melee. If the ranged attack hits, the disarmed weapon deals damage as if the barbarian had thrown it. The barbarian can choose to aim the disarmed weapon at a square rather than at a foe." prereq="4th-level barbarian"}

increased_damage_reduction.name: Increased Damage Reduction
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Increased Damage Reduction (Ex)&FN&" passive="The barbarian's damage reduction increases by 1/-. This increase is always active while the barbarian is *raging.*" special="A barbarian can select this rage power up to three times. Its effects stack." prereq="8th-level barbarian"}

internal_fortitude.name: Internal Fortitude
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Internal Fortitude (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian is immune to the sickened and nauseated conditions." prereq="8th-level barbarian"}

intimidating_glare.name: Intimidating Glare
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Intimidating Glare (Ex)&FN&" move="The barbarian can make an Intimidate check against one adjacent foe. If the barbarian successfully demoralizes her opponent, the foe is ‹misc/shaken› for 1d4 rounds + 1 round for every 5 points by which the barbarian's check exceeds the DC."}

battle_roar.name: Battle Roar
description: ::ab{icon=zap title="&L&Battle Roar (Su)&FN&" ability="When the character successfully demoralizes an opponent using *intimidating glare,* he also deals 1d6 points of sonic damage to that opponent." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/intimidating glare›"}

terrifying_howl.name: Terrifying Howl
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Terrifying Howl (Ex)&FN&" standard="The barbarian unleashes a terrifying howl. All ‹misc/shaken› enemies within 30 feet must make a Will save (DC equal to 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or be ‹misc/panicked› for 1d4+1 rounds." special="Once an enemy has made a save versus *terrifying howl* (successful or not), it is immune to this power for 24 hours." prereq="‹ragepower/Intimidating glare›, 8th-level barbarian"}

inured_to_the_dead.name: Inured to the Dead
description: ::ab{icon=def-roll title="&L&Inured to the Dead&FN&" passive="Once per *rage,* when the barbarian fails a saving throw against an effect created by an undead creature, she can reroll the saving throw. She must use the second result, even if it is worse. This does not require spending an action." prereq="4th-level barbarian"}

knockback.name: Knockback
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Knockback (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per round, the barbarian can make a ‹rule/bull rush› attempt against one target in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and is moved back as normal. The barbarian does not need to move with the target if successful." provokes=No}

knockdown.name: Knockdown
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Knockdown (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* the barbarian can make a ‹rule/trip› attack against one target in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and is knocked ‹rule/prone›." provokes=No}

linnorm_death_curse.name: Linnorm Death Curse
description: ## Linnorm Death Curse
"Linnorm Death Curse" can refer to seven different rage powers.
1. ‹ragepower/Cairn Linnorm Death Curse›
2. ‹ragepower/Crag Linnorm Death Curse›
3. ‹ragepower/Fjord Linnorm Death Curse›
4. ‹ragepower/Ice Linnorm Death Curse›
5. ‹ragepower/Taiga Linnorm Death Curse›
6. ‹ragepower/Tarn Linnorm Death Curse›
7. ‹ragepower/Tor Linnorm Death Curse›

cairn_linnorm_death_curse.name: Cairn Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Cairn Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/cairn linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of negative energy damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of decay* (Will negates)." prereq="8th-level barbarian"

::aff[Curse of Decay]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target takes 1 point of ‹rule/Con damage› per day and ‹rule/age«s› at a rate of 1 year per day (eventually incurring all of the penalties of old age but none of the bonuses)"}

crag_linnorm_death_curse.name: Crag Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Crag Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/crag linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of fire damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of fire* (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"
::aff[Curse of Fire]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target gains ‹umr/vulnerability› to fire"}

fjord_linnorm_death_curse.name: Fjord Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Fjord Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/fjord linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of cold damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of drowning* (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"

::aff[Curse of Drowning]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target is unable to breathe water (even with magic), can hold its breath only half as long as normal, and is ‹misc/sickened› whenever it holds its breath"}

ice_linnorm_death_curse.name: Ice Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Ice Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of an ‹monster/ice linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of cold damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed, the attacker suffers the *curse of frost.*" prereq="4th-level barbarian"
::aff[Curse of Frost]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target gains ‹umr/vulnerability› to cold"}

taiga_linnorm_death_curse.name: Taiga Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Taiga Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/taiga linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of electricity damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of electricity* (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"
::aff[Curse of Electricity]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target gains ‹umr/vulnerability› to electricity"}

tarn_linnorm_death_curse.name: Tarn Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Tarn Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/tarn linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of acid damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of death* (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"
::aff[Curse of Death]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target is no longer affected by healing spells and can't heal damage naturally by resting"}

tor_linnorm_death_curse.name: Tor Linnorm Death Curse
description: :::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Tor Linnorm Death Curse (Su)&FN&" action=Ability}

The character channels the power of a ‹monster/tor linnorm›. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of fire damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the *curse of boiling blood* (Will negates)." prereq="8th-level barbarian"

::aff[Curse of Boiling Blood]{iconC curse dcW dcLev=character dcMod=Charisma eff="Target gains ‹umr/vulnerability› to fire and is permanently ‹misc/staggered› from the pain of its boiling blood (this is a pain effect)"}

liquid_courage.name: Liquid Courage
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Liquid Courage (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian increases her morale bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects by +1 for each alcoholic drink she consumes during her *rage,* to a maximum of +1 increase per four barbarian levels."}

lizard_stride.name: Lizard Stride
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Lizard Stride (Su)&FN&" ability="When the barbarian makes a ‹rule/charge› or ‹rule/run› action while *raging,* she can move across the surface of water without sinking. She sinks immediately if she ends her turn standing on water."}

low_light_vision.name: Low-Light Vision
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Low-Light Vision (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian's senses sharpen and she gains low-light vision while *raging.*"}

night_vision.name: Night Vision
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Night Vision (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian's senses grow incredibly sharp while *raging* and she gains darkvision 60 feet." prereq="‹ragepower/Low-light vision› rage power or a low-light vision racial trait"}

master_of_the_deep.name: Master of the Deep
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Master of the Deep (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian commands an aquatic creature to do her bidding." standard="The barbarian selects a creature with the aquatic type within 30 feet and gives a terse command from those listed in the ‹spell/command› spell. Alternatively, if the creature has an Intelligence of 1 or 2, the barbarian may instead command the creature to attack the closest creature to it. The creature must succeed at a Will save (DC equal to 10 + half the barbarian's level + her Strength modifier) or obey the command to the best of its ability on its next turn." special="Once a creature has attempted a saving throw against master of the deep (successful or not), it is immune to this power for 24 hours. This ability is a mind-affecting effect, but it is not language dependent; the creature need not understand the barbarian giving the command." prereq="8th-level barbarian"}

mighty_swing.name: Mighty Swing
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Mighty Swing (Ex)&FN&" immediate="The barbarian automatically confirms a critical hit. This power can be used once a critical threat has been determined." prereq="12th-level barbarian" special="This power can only be used once per *rage.*"}

moment_of_clarity.name: Moment of Clarity
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Moment of Clarity (Ex)&FN&" swift="The barbarian does not gain any benefits or take any of the penalties from *rage* for 1 round. This includes the penalty to Armor Class and the restriction on what actions can be performed. This round still counts against her total number of rounds of *rage* per day." usage="Once per *rage*"}

perfect_clarity.name: Perfect Clarity
description: ::ab{icon=def-roll title="&L&Perfect Clarity (Ex)&FN&" ability="While using her *moment of clarity* rage power, the barbarian can roll twice for any miss chance or Will saving throws to disbelieve illusions, taking the better result." prereq="‹ragepower/Moment of clarity›"}

ultimate_clarity.name: Ultimate Clarity
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Ultimate Clarity (Su)&FN&" usage="Once per *rage*" ability="The character can refine her senses, seeing through normal and magical darkness (including from magical effects such as ‹spell/blur› and ‹spell/displacement›), ‹spell/invisibility›, and illusions; she can also discern the exact locations of creatures with ‹rule/concealment›. This lasts for 1 round." special="The character does not need to be using *moment of clarity* to use this rage power." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/moment of clarity›, ‹ragepower/perfect clarity›"}

overbearing_advance.name: Overbearing Advance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Overbearing Advance (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian inflicts damage equal to her Strength bonus whenever she succeeds at an ‹rule/overrun› combat maneuver."}

overbearing_onslaught.name: Overbearing Onslaught
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Overbearing Onslaught (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian may ‹rule/overrun› more than one target per round, with a -2 penalty on her CMB for each overrun check after the first." prereq="‹ragepower/Overbearing advance›, 6th-level barbarian"}

no_escape.name: No Escape
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&No Escape (Ex)&FN&" immediate="When an adjacent foe uses a ‹rule/withdraw› action to move away from her, the barbarian can move up to double her normal speed. She must end her movement adjacent to the enemy that used the withdraw action. The barbarian provokes attacks of opportunity as normal during this movement." usage="Once per *rage*"}

pack_rage.name: Pack Rage
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Pack Rage (Ex)&FN&" ability="When a barbarian with this rage power enters a *rage,* any barbarian within 30 feet who also has this rage power can enter a *rage.* A barbarian that enters a *rage* outside of her turn spends 1 round of *rage* immediately and then spends another round of *rage* to maintain her *rage* at the beginning of her next turn." prereq="6th-level barbarian"}

powerful_blow.name: Powerful Blow
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Powerful Blow (Ex)&FN&" swift="The barbarian gains a bonus on a single damage roll. @B-4f1-barbarian. This power is used before the roll to hit is made." usage="Once per *rage*"}

bleeding_blow.name: Bleeding Blow
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Bleeding Blow (Ex)&FN&" passive="When she uses her *powerful blow* rage power, the barbarian also deals ‹rule/bleed› damage equal to her bonus damage with the *powerful blow.* This bleed damage bypasses damage reduction." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/powerful blow›"}

crippling_blow.name: Crippling Blow
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Crippling Blow (Ex)&FN&" ability="When using her *powerful blow* rage power, the barbarian can forgo the normal bonus to damage (including any bleed damage granted by the ‹ragepower/bleeding blow› rage power or similar boosts to the damage of the *powerful blow* rage power) and instead deals 1 point of ‹rule/ability damage› to the target's Strength or Dexterity score for every four class levels the barbarian has attained. The target can attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) to halve this ability damage." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/powerful blow›"}

quick_reflexes.name: Quick Reflexes
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Quick Reflexes (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can make one additional attack of opportunity per round."}

raging_climber.name: Raging Climber
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Raging Climber (Ex)&FN&" passive="When *raging,* the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all ‹skill/Climb› skill checks."}

bestial_climber.name: Bestial Climber
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Bestial Climber (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a natural climb speed equal to her land speed." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/raging climber›"}

raging_flyer.name: Raging Flyer
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Raging Flyer (Ex)&FN&" passive="When *raging,* the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus to ‹skill/Fly› checks."}

bestial_flyer.name: Bestial Flyer
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Bestial Flyer (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian's fly speed increases by 10 feet and her maneuverability improves by one category." prereq="A fly speed (before *raging,*) ‹ragepower/raging flyer›, 6th-level barbarian"}

raging_leaper.name: Raging Leaper
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Raging Leaper (Ex)&FN&" passive="When *raging,* the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all ‹skill/Acrobatics› skill checks made to jump. When making a jump in this way, the barbarian is always considered to have a running start."}

bestial_leaper.name: Bestial Leaper
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Bestial Leaper (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can take a @HLmove_action to move and can take her normal @HLstandard_action at any point during the move." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/raging leaper›"}

raging_flier.name: Raging Flier
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Raging Flier (Su)&FN&" move="Once per *rage,* the character can fly up to her base speed. If she uses the ‹rule/charge› action, she can use this flight as part of her movement during the charge." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/raging leaper›"}

raging_grappler.name: Raging Grappler
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Raging Grappler (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian grapples her foes with the power and viciousness of a river crocodile. As long as she is *raging,* whenever the barbarian succeeds at a check to start a ‹rule/grapple›, she can choose to deal damage as if she had also succeeded at a check to maintain the grapple.~~~In addition, while she is *raging,* whenever the barbarian succeeds at a combat maneuver check to maintain a grapple, she can choose to give herself, the target of her grapple, or both the ‹rule/prone› condition as a @HLfree_action while continuing to maintain the grapple."}

raging_swimmer.name: Raging Swimmer
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Raging Swimmer (Ex)&FN&" passive="When *raging,* the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all ‹skill/Swim› skill checks."}

bestial_swimmer.name: Bestial Swimmer
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Bestial Swimmer (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a natural swim speed equal to her normal land speed." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/raging swimmer›"}

raging_whirlwind.name: Raging Whirlwind
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Raging Whirlwind (Su)&FN&" immediate="The barbarian can create a whirlwind with a powerful spinning move after she confirms a critical hit with a melee attack. The whirlwind circles the target of her melee attack, lifting it in the air slightly until the end of the barbarian's turn. The creature can attempt a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier) to negate this effect. If it fails the save, the target loses its Dexterity modifier to AC for the rest of the barbarian's turn and lands ‹rule/prone› on the ground at the end of her turn." special="Raging whirlwind has no effect on flying creatures." prereq="12th-level barbarian"}

reckless_abandon.name: Reckless Abandon
description: ::ab{icon=boost-down title="&L&Reckless Abandon (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian can take a penalty to AC to gain a bonus on attack rolls. The penalty and bonus are both equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level."}

inspire_ferocity.name: Inspire Ferocity
description: ::ab{icon=boost-down title="&L&Inspire Ferocity (Ex)&FN&" move="While *raging,* the barbarian can impart her *reckless abandon* modifier to all willing allies within 30 feet for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1)." prereq="‹ragepower/Reckless abandon›"}

renewed_vigor.name: Renewed Vigor
description: ::ab{icon=aid title="&L&Renewed Vigor (Ex)&FN&" standard="The barbarian heals 1d8 points of damage + her Constitution modifier. For every four levels the barbarian has attained above 4th, this amount of damage healed increases by 1d8, to a maximum of 5d8 at 20th level." usage="Once per day" special="This power can be used only while *raging.*" prereq="4th-level barbarian"}

regenerative_vigor.name: Regenerative Vigor
description: ::ab{icon=aid title="&L&Regenerative Vigor (Ex)&FN&" passive="After using her *renewed vigor* rage power until her current *rage* ends, the barbarian gains ‹umr/fast healing› equal to ‹misc/one-sixth› of her barbarian level. She regains hit points from *fast healing* at the start of each of her turns." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/renewed vigor›"}

renewed_vitality.name: Renewed Vitality
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Renewed Vitality (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian ignores the effect of 1 point of ability penalty or damage per two barbarian levels she has (maximum 10)." ability="Once per day, when a barbarian with ability penalties or damage ends her *rage,* she can reroll a saving throw, if any, against an effect that imposed an ability penalty or dealt her ability damage. If successful, she removes an amount of ability penalty or damage equal to the amount she can ignore while *raging.*" order=pa prereq="4th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/renewed vigor›"}

renewed_life.name: Renewed Life
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Renewed Life (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian ignores the effect of one temporary ‹rule/negative level› per four barbarian levels she has (maximum 5)." ability="Once per day, when a barbarian with temporary negative levels ends her *rage,* she can attempt saving throws to remove a number of negative levels equal to the number of levels she could ignore while *raging.*" order=pa prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/renewed vitality›"}

roaring_drunk.name: Roaring Drunk
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Roaring Drunk (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a +1 morale bonus on Intimidate checks and to the save DC of any fear effects she creates for each alcoholic drink she has consumed during her *rage,* to a maximum of +1 per four barbarian levels."}

rolling_dodge.name: Rolling Dodge
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Rolling Dodge (Ex)&FN&" move="The barbarian gains a dodge bonus to her Armor Class against ranged attacks for a number of rounds equal to the barbarian's current Constitution modifier (minimum 1). @B-6f1-barbarian." provokes=No}

reflexive_dodge.name: Reflexive Dodge
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Reflexive Dodge (Ex)&FN&" passive="While using her *rolling dodge* rage power, the barbarian may apply her dodge bonus to AC as a bonus on Reflex saving throws." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/rolling dodge›"}

roused_anger.name: Roused Anger
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Roused Anger (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian may enter a *rage* even if fatigued. While *raging* after using this ability, the barbarian is immune to the ‹misc/fatigued› condition. Once this *rage* ends, the barbarian is ‹misc/exhausted› for 10 minutes per round spent *raging.*"}

savage_dirty_trick.name: Savage Dirty Trick
description: :::ab{icon=melee-lower title="&L&Savage Dirty Trick (Ex)&FN&" action=Ability prereq="6th-level barbarian" usage="Once per opponent per *rage*" provokes=No}

Once per round while *raging,* the barbarian can attempt a ‹rule/dirty trick› combat maneuver in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes an amount of damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or take an additional penalty from the dirty trick based on the type of dirty trick performed and the following table.
| Initial Penalty | Additional Penalty |
| @ripple[misc/Blinded] | @ripple[misc/Staggered] |
| @ripple[misc/Dazzled] | @ripple[misc/Dazed] |
| @ripple[misc/Deafened] | Staggered |
| @ripple[rule/Entangled] | Anchored in place and unable to move from that square |
| @ripple[misc/Sickened] | @ripple[misc/Nauseated] |

On a failed Fortitude save, the opponent takes this additional penalty on top of the dirty trick's original effect. The additional penalty lasts for 1 round (though the initial penalty lasts as long as normal), and can be removed with a move action. The initial effect cannot be removed via mundane means until the additional penalty is removed (though magical effects like ‹spell/remove blindness/deafness› work). Removing the initial effect also removes the additional penalty. If the target is immune to the initial penalty, then it is unaffected by the additional penalty.

For example, a barbarian using this rage power attempts a dirty trick combat maneuver against her opponent to blind him. She succeeds and her opponent fails his Fortitude save, so he becomes staggered as well as blinded. Regardless of whether he had succeeded at his saving throw, the opponent still takes an amount of damage from the barbarian's combat maneuver equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier (unless he has damage reduction or would otherwise be able to prevent this damage). Likewise, if her opponent were immune to blinding effects, he would not suffer from the blindness or the staggering effect, regardless of his saving throw.

savage_hurl.name: Savage Hurl
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Savage Hurl (Ex)&FN&" passive="The barbarian gains a +1 bonus on ranged attack rolls with thrown weapons that add her Dexterity bonus to the attack roll." imp4="This bonus increases to +2 if the barbarian's Strength modifier is at least +4." imp8="It increases to +3 if her Strength modifier is at least +6." imp12="It becomes +4 at if her Strength modifier is at least +8."}

savage_intuition.name: Savage Intuition
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Savage Intuition&FN&" flavor="Your bestial senses allow you to sense danger and become enraged before you even have time to consciously react to danger." ability="sWhen combat begins, if you have rounds of *rage* remaining, you may automatically enter a *rage* without using an action at the start of the first round of combat (or at the start of the surprise round, if there is one), even if you are not otherwise aware that combat has begun." prereq="‹race/Wereboar-kin› or associated with wereboar-kin"}

scent.name: Scent
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Scent (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian gains the ‹umr/scent› ability while *raging* and can use this ability to locate unseen foes."}

primal_scent.name: Primal Scent
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Primal Scent (Ex)&FN&" passive="When using her *scent* rage power, the barbarian adds half her barbarian level on Survival checks made to track by scent and on Perception checks to pinpoint the location of creatures she cannot see.~~~If she pinpoints the location of a creature that has total concealment, she treats it as having ‹rule/concealment›." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/scent›"}

smasher.name: Smasher
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Smasher (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* whenever the barbarian makes an attack against an unattended object or a ‹rule/sunder› combat maneuver, she can ignore the object's hardness. This ability must be used before the attack roll or sunder check is made."}

gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Gearbreaker (Ex)&FN&" ability="Once per round while *raging,* whenever the barbarian makes an attack against a construct, she can ignore an amount of that construct's hardness equal to her barbarian level. This ability must be used before the attack roll is made." special="This power stacks with the *hard hitter* ability from the ‹arc-barbarian/Numerian liberator› archetype." prereq="‹ragepower/Smasher›"}

spiritual_awareness.name: Spiritual Awareness
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Spiritual Awareness&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian's dodge bonus to AC from *trap sense* applies against attacks made by incorporeal creatures." prereq="‹ability/Trap sense›"}

spring_rage.name: Spring Rage
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Spring Rage (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian's *rage* rejuvenates her physically and spiritually." passive="While *raging,* she ignores penalties to her ability scores due to ‹rule/aging›. She also ignores penalties from ‹rule/negative levels›, though she retains any negative levels she has until they are removed normally." special="A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between spring, ‹ragepower/summer<_rage›, ‹ragepower/autumn<_rage›, or ‹ragepower/winter<_rage› rage."}

staggering_drunk.name: Staggering Drunk
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Staggering Drunk (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* a barbarian gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity for each alcoholic drink she has consumed during her *rage,* to a maximum of +1 per four barbarian levels."}

strength_surge.name: Strength Surge
description: ::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Strength Surge (Ex)&FN&" immediate="The barbarian adds her barbarian level on one Strength check or combat maneuver check, or to her Combat Maneuver Defense when an opponent attempts a maneuver against her." usage="Once per *rage*"}

suffocating_grip.name: Suffocating Grip
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Suffocating Grip (Ex)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* when the barbarian successfully maintains a grapple, she can choke her opponent instead of dealing damage to, moving, pinning, or tying up her opponent. The grappled opponent cannot speak or breathe and must ‹misc/hold its breath› or begin ‹rule/suffocati«ng<on›." special="The grappled opponent can take a breath during any round in which the barbarian does not maintain the grapple. Creatures that do not breathe are not affected by this ability."}

greater_suffocating_grip.name: Greater Suffocating Grip
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Greater Suffocating Grip (Ex)&FN&" ability="When the barbarian is using the *suffocating grip* rage power, the grappled creature cannot hold its breath and immediately begins ‹rule/suffocati«ng<on›." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/suffocating grip›"}

summer_rage.name: Summer Rage
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Summer Rage (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian channels the heat of late summer, making the air around her hot and oppressive." ability="A creature within the barbarian's reach becomes ‹misc/fatigued› as long as it remains within the barbarian's reach unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier) to become immune for 24 hours." special="A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between ‹ragepower/spring<_rage›, summer, ‹ragepower/autumn<_rage›, or ‹ragepower/winter<_rage› rage."}

superstition.name: Superstition
description: ::ab{icon=def-down title="&L&Superstition (Ex)&FN&" passive="The barbarian gains a morale bonus on saving throws made to resist spells, supernatural abilities, and spell-like abilities. @B-4f2-barbarian." special="While *raging,* the barbarian cannot be a willing target of any spell and must make saving throws to resist all spells, even those cast by allies."}

disruptive.name: Disruptive
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Disruptive&FN&" ability="When *raging,* the barbarian gains ‹feat/Disruptive› as a bonus feat." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/superstition›"}

eater_of_magic.name: Eater of Magic
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Eater of Magic (Su)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* when a barbarian fails a saving throw against a spell, supernatural ability, or spell-like ability, she can reroll the saving throw against the effect (this is not an action). If she succeeds at the second saving throw, she is not affected by the spell, supernatural ability, or spell-like ability and gains a number of ‹rule/temporary hit points› equal to the effect's caster level (in the case of spell or spell-like abilities) or the CR of the effect's creator (in the case of supernatural abilities). These temporary hit points last until damage is applied to them or 1 minute, whichever occurs first." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/superstition›"}

spellbreaker.name: Spellbreaker
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Spellbreaker&FN&" ability="When *raging,* the barbarian gains ‹feat/Spellbreaker› as a bonus feat." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/disruptive›"}

witch_hunter.name: Witch Hunter
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Witch Hunter (Ex)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a bonus on damage rolls against creatures possessing spells or spell-like abilities. This damage bonus is equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level." prereq="‹ragepower/Superstition›"}

spell_sunder.name: Spell Sunder
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Spell Sunder (Su)&FN&" ability="Once per *rage,* the barbarian can attempt to ‹rule/sunder› an ongoing spell effect by succeeding at a combat maneuver check.~~~For any effect other than one on a creature, the barbarian must make her combat maneuver check against a CMD of 15 plus the effect's caster level. To sunder an effect on a creature, the barbarian must succeed at a normal sunder combat maneuver against the creature's CMD + 5, ignoring any miss chance caused by a spell or spell-like ability.~~~If successful, the barbarian suppresses the effect for 1 round, or 2 rounds if she exceeded the CMD by 5 to 9. If she exceeds the CMD by 10 or more, the effect is dispelled." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/witch hunter›"}

sunder_enchantment.name: Sunder Enchantment
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Sunder Enchantment (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* whenever the barbarian succeeds at a ‹rule/sunder› combat maneuver on a magical item, that item's magical abilities are suppressed for 1 round, plus 1 round for every 5 points by which her combat maneuver check exceeded the target's CMD." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/spell sunder›"}

surprise_accuracy.name: Surprise Accuracy
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Surprise Accuracy (Ex)&FN&" swift="The barbarian gains a morale bonus on one attack roll equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level. This power must be used before the roll to hit is made." usage="Once per *rage*"}

deadly_accuracy.name: Deadly Accuracy
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Deadly Accuracy (Ex)&FN&" ability="If the barbarian scores a critical threat when using her *surprise accuracy* rage power, she applies double the surprise accuracy bonus when rolling to confirm the critical." prereq="4th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/surprise accuracy›"}

lethal_accuracy.name: Lethal Accuracy
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Lethal Accuracy (Ex)&FN&" passive="When using her *surprise accuracy* rage power, the barbarian's critical multiplier for damage increases by 1 (a &times&2 multiplier becomes &times&3, a 19-20/&times&2 multiplier becomes 19-20/&times&3, a &times&3 multiplier becomes &times&4, and a &times&4 multiplier becomes &times&5)." prereq="16th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/surprise accuracy›, ‹ragepower/deadly accuracy›"}

sharpened_accuracy.name: Sharpened Accuracy
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Sharpened Accuracy (Ex)&FN&" passive="When using her *surprise accuracy *rage power, the barbarian ignores the miss chance for ‹rule/concealment› and treats total concealment as concealment. She also ignores cover penalties except those from total cover." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/surprise accuracy›"}

swift_foot.name: Swift Foot
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Swift Foot (Ex)&FN&" passive="The barbarian gains a 5-foot enhancement bonus to her speed. This increase is always active while the barbarian is *raging.*" special="A barbarian can select this rage power up to three times. Its effects stack."}

sprint.name: Sprint
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Sprint (Ex)&FN&" usage="Once per *rage*" fullround="The barbarian can move up to 6 times her speed or a single full-round ‹rule/charge› action to move up to 3 times her speed." prereq="4th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/swift foot›"}

two_fanged_pounce.name: Two-Fanged Pounce
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Two-Fanged Pounce&FN&" ability="If the barbarian is wielding a pair of ‹eq-weapon/dagger«s›, ‹eq-weapon/kukri«s›, or ‹eq-weapon/punching dagger«s›, she can attack once with each of the two weapons when she ‹rule/charge«s›. If she does, she loses the bonus on attack rolls for charging and takes an additional -2 penalty to her AC, and she applies ‹misc/precision damage› or effects that occur on a hit only once, even if she hits with both attacks."}

unexpected_strike.name: Unexpected Strike
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Unexpected Strike (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian can make an attack of opportunity against a foe that moves into any square threatened by the barbarian, regardless of whether or not that movement would normally provoke an attack of opportunity." usage="Once per *rage*" prereq="8th-level barbarian"}

unrestrained_rage.name: Unrestrained Rage
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Unrestrained Rage&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian is immune to paralysis." special="If the barbarian is targeted by an effect that would cause her to become ‹rule/paralyzed›, she can enter a *rage* as an @HLimmediate_action, as long as she still has rounds of *rage* remaining." prereq="12th-level barbarian"}

water_sense.name: Water Sense
description: ::ab{icon=lower-boost title="&L&Water Sense (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian's senses are no longer fooled by the rippling surface and confounding reflections seen in water that is being used as ‹rule/cover› by her foes. While the barbarian is *raging* and on land, opponents in the water gain only partial cover from her attacks, instead of improved cover. In addition, while on land and targeting an opponent in water, she takes only a -1 penalty on attacks with ranged weapons (including thrown weapons) for every 5 feet of water they pass through (instead of the usual -2 penalty for every 5 feet of water)."}

winter_rage.name: Winter Rage
description: ::ab{icon=cone title="&L&Winter Rage (Su)&FN&" standard="The barbarian can bellow a 20-foot cone of frigid, snowy air. Until the beginning of the barbarian's next turn, creatures moving through the cone move at half speed." special="A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between ‹ragepower/spring<_rage›, ‹ragepower/summer<_rage›, ‹ragepower/autumn<_rage›, or winter rage."}

aryzuls_curse.name: Aryzul's Curse
description: ::ab{icon=aura title="&L&Aryzul's Curse (Su)&FN&" passive="When *raging,* the barbarian emanates a 5-foot-radius aura of radioactivity. Each round that another creature begins its turn within this aura, it takes a cumulative -2 penalty to Strength (Fortitude negates, DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier) for the duration of the *rage.* A creature's Strength penalty from this ability cannot exceed the barbarian's class level." imp12="The barbarian can choose to create a 10-foot-radius aura of radioactivity when she begins her *rage.*" &Elemental&}
replacements: prereq="6th-level barbarian or ‹class/skald› with ‹ragepower/lesser elemental rage› or ‹ragepower/lesser elemental blood›; or 6th-level ‹class/unchained barbarian› with ‹ragepower/elemental stance› (and must adopt that stance to use this power)"

hshurhas_veil.name: Hshurha's Veil
description: ::ab{icon=power-boost title="&L&Hshurha's Veil (Su)&FN&" ability="When *raging,* the barbarian can use Stealth, and she gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her barbarian level on Stealth checks plus the benefits of ‹rule/concealment› against ranged attacks and attacks of opportunity." &Elemental&}
replacements: prereq="6th-level barbarian or ‹class/skald› with ‹ragepower/lesser elemental rage› or ‹ragepower/lesser elemental blood›; or 6th-level ‹class/unchained barbarian› with ‹ragepower/elemental stance› (and must adopt that stance to use this power)"

kelizandris_tide.name: Kelizandri's Tide
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Kelizandri's Tide (Su)&FN&" order=rf fullround="When the barbarian *rages,* enemies find it difficult to escape the vortex of her fury." fullround="The barbarian can attempt a single combat maneuver check against each creature within 10 feet of her. If her roll equals or exceeds a creature's CMD, she moves that creature 5 feet closer to her." free="Once per day after attempting this maneuver, she can attack each adjacent creature as if using the ‹feat/Whirlwind Attack› feat. If she has the Whirlwind Attack feat, she can also use it as a free action in this way one additional time per day." &Elemental&}
replacements: prereq="6th-level barbarian or ‹class/skald› with ‹ragepower/lesser elemental rage› or ‹ragepower/lesser elemental blood›; or 6th-level ‹class/unchained barbarian› with ‹ragepower/elemental stance› (and must adopt that stance to use this power)"

ymeris_pyre.name: Ymeri's Pyre
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Ymeri's Pyre (Su)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian visibly burns with an inner flame that consumes all impurities affecting her." ability="Each round that the barbarian *rages* reduces the duration of negative spells and effects inflicted upon her as if 2 rounds had passed; this has no effect on the duration of such effects against other creatures." ability2="Once per day, the barbarian can expend 5 rounds of *rage* to attempt a new saving throw against each non-permanent effect currently affecting her. Each successful saving throw ends the related effect, and she can choose not to make a save against an effect." order=a2 &Elemental&}
replacements: prereq="6th-level barbarian or ‹class/skald› with ‹ragepower/lesser elemental rage› or ‹ragepower/lesser elemental blood›; or 6th-level ‹class/unchained barbarian› with ‹ragepower/elemental stance› (and must adopt that stance to use this power)"

lesser_ancestor_totem.name: Lesser Ancestor Totem
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Lesser Ancestor Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="When she enters a *rage,* the barbarian selects a skill of her choice, which must be one she can use while *raging,* such as Climb or Intimidate. While *raging,* she gains a +2 insight bonus to the chosen skill." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

ancestor_totem.name: Ancestor Totem
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Ancestor Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="The barbarian's insight bonus to her chosen skill increases to +4. The barbarian can now select any skill to receive this bonus, even a Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skill or a skill that requires patience or concentration; if she selects such a skill, she can use it even while *raging.*" prereq="‹ragepower/Lesser ancestor totem›, 6th-level barbarian"}

greater_ancestor_totem.name: Greater Ancestor Totem
description: ::ab{icon=boost-roll title="&L&Greater Ancestor Totem (Su)&FN&" order=pi passive="The barbarian's insight bonus to her chosen skill increases to +6." immediate="Once per *rage,* she can spend one round of *rage* to reroll a skill check in the chosen skill. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is lower." prereq="‹ragepower/Ancestor totem›, 10th-level barbarian"}

lesser_atavism_totem.name: Lesser Atavism Totem
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Lesser Atavism Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="The barbarian gains a ‹umr/bite attack›; if she already has a bite attack, it deals damage as if the barbarian were one size larger." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

atavism_totem.name: Atavism Totem
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Atavism Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="The barbarian gains ‹umr/ferocity›." prereq="‹ragepower/Lesser atavism totem›, 6th-level barbarian"}

greater_atavism_totem.name: Greater Atavism Totem
description: ::ab{icon=power-melee title="&L&Greater Atavism Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="The barbarian gains ‹umr/trample›." prereq="‹ragepower/Atavism totem›, 10th-level barbarian"}

lesser_beast_totem.name: Lesser Beast Totem
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Lesser Beast Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains two ‹umr/claw attack«s›. These attacks are considered primary attacks and are made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus. The claws deal 1d6 points of slashing damage (1d4 if Small) plus the barbarian's Strength modifier." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

beast_totem.name: Beast Totem
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Beast Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a natural armor bonus. @B-4f1-barbarian." prereq="‹ragepower/Lesser beast totem›, 6th-level barbarian"}

greater_beast_totem.name: Greater Beast Totem
description: ::ab{icon=melee-boost title="&L&Greater Beast Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains the ‹umr/pounce› special ability, allowing her to make a full attack at the end of a charge. In addition, the damage from her claws increases to 1d8 (1d6 if Small) and the claws deal &times&3 damage on a critical hit." prereq="‹ragepower/Beast totem›, 10th-level barbarian"}

lesser_celestial_totem.name: Lesser Celestial Totem
description: ::ab{icon=aid-boost title="&L&Lesser Celestial Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian benefits from increased magical healing. Whenever she is subject to a spell that cures hit point damage, she heals 1 additional point of damage per caster level. In the case of non-spell healing effects (such as ‹ability/channel«ed» energy› or ‹ability/lay on hands›), she heals a number of additional points equal to the class level of the character performing the magical healing. This does not affect fast healing or regeneration." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

celestial_totem.name: Celestial Totem
description: ::ab{icon=magic title="&L&Celestial Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian shines with a righteous light. This effect bestows upon the barbarian a halo of gleaming light that shines as if it were ‹spell/daylight› and triggers an ‹spell/invisibility purge› effect in the barbarian's square and each adjacent square. The *invisibility purge* only affects nongood creatures." prereq="8th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser celestial totem›"}

greater_celestial_totem.name: Greater Celestial Totem
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Greater Celestial Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains spell resistance equal to 11 + the barbarian's class level against spells with the evil descriptor. She also gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against spells and effects from evil creatures." prereq="12th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/celestial totem›"}

lesser_chaos_totem.name: Lesser Chaos Totem
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Lesser Chaos Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC against the attacks of lawful creatures and a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws against confusion, insanity, polymorph, and effects with the lawful descriptor. This bonus increases by +1 for each chaos totem rage power she possesses." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

chaos_totem.name: Chaos Totem
description: ::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Chaos Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian's form becomes infused with chaos.
