She gains a +4 bonus on Escape Artist checks and has a 25% chance to ignore extra damage from critical hits and sneak attacks." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser chaos totem›"}

greater_chaos_totem.name: Greater Chaos Totem
description: ::ab{icon=def-boost title="&L&Greater Chaos Totem (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains DR/lawful equal to 1/2 her barbarian level. Her weapons and natural weapons are considered chaotic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/chaos totem›"}

lesser_cult_totem.name: Lesser Cult Totem
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Lesser Cult Totem (Ex)&FN&" passive="While the barbarian is *raging,* any morale bonuses or bonuses for ‹rule/flanking› she gains on attacks rolls are added to her damage rolls instead of her attack rolls. They are still morale bonuses, and they don't stack with other morale bonuses on damage rolls." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

cult_totem.name: Cult Totem
description: ::ab{icon=protect title="&L&Cult Totem (Ex)&FN&" ability="The barbarian can make an attack of opportunity against a creature within her reach who damages an ally of the barbarian with a melee attack. Only the enemy, not the barbarian's ally, needs to be within the barbarian's melee reach in order for the barbarian to make this attack of opportunity." special="Once the barbarian makes an attack of opportunity against a creature with this ability, she can't use this ability to make an attack of opportunity against the same creature for 24 hours." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser cult totem›"}

greater_cult_totem.name: Greater Cult Totem
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Greater Cult Totem (Ex)&FN&" passive="While the barbarian is *raging,* when she takes hit point damage that would render her ‹misc/dying› or ‹misc/dead›, she remains conscious and *raging* until the end of her next turn after taking that damage, though she is ‹misc/disabled› during that turn. She becomes dying or dead at the end of her next turn as normal for her current hit point total." special="This ability has no effect if the barbarian dies from a cause other than hit point damage, such as from a death effect or if her Constitution damage exceeds her Constitution score." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser cult totem›, ‹ragepower/cult totem›"}

lesser_daemon_totem.name: Lesser Daemon Totem
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against acid damage, death effects, disease, and poison. This bonus increases by 1 for each daemon totem rage power the barbarian has, excluding this one." &Totem&}
replacements: special="@HLTotem_rage_powers are only available to barbarians taking the ‹arc-barbarian/Totem Warrior› archetype. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers; for example, a barbarian who selects a *beast* totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the *dragon* totem rage powers (any rage power with &quot&dragon totem&quot& in its title)."

daemon_totem.name: Daemon Totem
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Daemon Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="While the barbarian is *raging,* her melee attacks impose a temporary ‹rule/negative level› on her opponent on a successful critical hit. After 1 hour, these temporary negative levels disappear automatically (without a saving throw)." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser daemon totem›"}

greater_daemon_totem.name: Greater Daemon Totem
description: ::ab{icon=aid title="&L&Greater Daemon Totem (Su)&FN&" ability="If the barbarian kills an intelligent creature with a CR equal to at least half her character level while *raging,* she heals 5 hit points. If she is already at her maximum number of hit points, she instead gains 5 ‹rule/temporary hit points›, which don't stack if she kills multiple creatures." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser daemon totem›, ‹ragepower/daemon totem›"}

dragon_totem.name: Dragon Totem
description: ::ab{icon=boost-def title="&L&Dragon Totem (Su)&FN&" order=cp choice="The barbarian must select a single color of dragon (black, blue, brass, bronze, copper, gold, green, red, silver, or white) as her totem." passive="While *raging,* she gains a +1 bonus on Perception checks and a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear, paralysis, and sleep effects. description: ::ab{icon=power-boost title="&L&Greater Elemental Blood (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a special movement type or bonus based on her chosen element: **acid** grants a burrow speed of 30 feet, **cold** grants a swim speed of 60 feet, **fire** grants an increase of 30 feet to her base land speed, and **electricity** grants a fly speed of 60 feet (good maneuverability)." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/elemental blood›"}

lesser_fey_blood.name: Lesser Fey Blood
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Lesser Fey Blood (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* each time the barbarian confirms a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier) or be ‹misc/confused› for one round." special="This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect." &Blood&}
replacements: special="**Blood** rage powers grant powers in a theme. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of blood rage powers."

fey_blood.name: Fey Blood
description: ::ab{icon=power title="&L&Fey Blood (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* when the barbarian ‹rule/charge«s›, she ignores ‹rule/difficult terrain› (including magical terrain, but not other creatures)." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser fey blood›"}

greater_fey_blood.name: Greater Fey Blood
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Greater Fey Blood (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* as long as the barbarian moves at least 10 feet, she gain the effects of ‹spell/blur› for 1 round." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/fey blood›"}

lesser_infernal_blood.name: Lesser Infernal Blood
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Lesser Infernal Blood (Su)&FN&" swift="While *raging,* the barbarian can infuse her attacks with hellfire for 1 round. During this time, all of her melee attacks gain the ‹magic-enh/flaming› magic weapon special ability." usage="3 times/day" &Blood&}
replacements: special="**Blood** rage powers grant powers in a theme. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of blood rage powers."

infernal_blood.name: Infernal Blood
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Infernal Blood (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains fire ‹umr/resistance› 5, as well as a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser infernal blood›"}

greater_infernal_blood.name: Greater Infernal Blood
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Greater Infernal Blood (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains a +4 bonus against enchantment and fear effects." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/infernal blood›"}

lesser_undead_blood.name: Lesser Undead Blood
description: ::ab{icon=lower title="&L&Lesser Undead Blood (Su)&FN&" ability="While *raging,* when the barbarian hits a creature with a ‹misc/charge› attack, the creature she hit becomes ‹misc/shaken› for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 her barbarian level (minimum 1). This effect does not stack with other fear effects to cause a stronger condition." &Blood&}
replacements: special="**Blood** rage powers grant powers in a theme. A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of blood rage powers."

undead_blood.name: Undead Blood
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Undead Blood (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* all of the barbarian's melee attacks are treated as if they were made with a weapon with the ‹magic-enh/ghost touch› weapon special ability." prereq="6th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/lesser undead blood›"}

greater_undead_blood.name: Greater Undead Blood
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Greater Undead Blood (Su)&FN&" passive="While *raging,* the barbarian gains cold ‹umr/resistance› 10, as well as DR 10/- against nonlethal damage." prereq="10th-level barbarian, ‹ragepower/undead blood›"}

accurate_stance.name: Accurate Stance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Accurate Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can focus her strikes." passive="She gains a competence bonus on melee attack rolls and thrown weapon attack rolls. @B-4f1-barbarian."}

calm_stance.name: Calm Stance
description: ::ab{icon=down-boost title="&L&Calm Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can enter a state of calm." passive="While in this stance, the barbarian doesn't gain any benefits from *rage* other than the temporary hit points, but she doesn't take any of the penalties from *rage* (including the penalty to AC and the restriction on actions she can take). Rounds spent in a calm stance still count against her total number of rounds of *rage* per day."}

elemental_stance.name: Elemental Stance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Elemental Stance (Su)&FN&" passive="When the barbarian adopts this stance, she chooses an energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). Her melee attacks deal 1 additional point of damage of the chosen type." imp8="This damage increases to 1d6 points." imp12="The barbarian's critical hits deal an additional 1d10 points of energy damage of the same type (2d10 if the weapon deals &times&3 damage on a critical hit, 3d10 if the weapon deals &times&4 damage on a critical hit)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"}

guarded_stance_stance.name: Guarded Stance
description: ::ab{icon=def title="&L&Guarded Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can take on a more defensive posture." passive="This grants her a dodge bonus to her Armor Class for the duration of her current *rage.* @B-4f1-barbarian."}

knockdown_stance.name: Knockdown Stance
description: ::ab{icon=melee title="&L&Knockdown Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can focus on toppling her foes." ability="Once per round, she can make a ‹rule/trip› attack against one target in place of a melee attack. If she succeeds, the target is knocked ‹rule/prone›." provokes=No}

powerful_stance.name: Powerful Stance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Powerful Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can focus her ferocity." passive="She gains a bonus on melee damage rolls and thrown weapon damage rolls. @B-4f1-barbarian."}

reckless_stance.name: Reckless Stance
description: ::ab{icon=boost-down title="&L&Reckless Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can attack with abandon at the expense of her defense." passive="She gains a bonus on attack rolls, but takes a penalty to AC. This bonus and penalty are equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level."}

regenerative_stance.name: Regenerative Stance
description: ::ab{icon=aid title="&L&Regenerative Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can continually replenish her health." passive="At the start of her turn, she regains temporary hit points equal to ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level, but this cannot give her more than her maximum temporary hit points from *rage.*" prereq="4th-level barbarian"}

strength_stance.name: Strength Stance
description: ::ab{icon=boost title="&L&Strength Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can summon mighty strength." passive="She gains a competence bonus on combat maneuvers and to her CMD. These bonuses are equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fourth› of her barbarian level. In addition, she gains a +8 competence bonus on Strength checks to lift, push, bend, or break objects (this does not apply to combat maneuvers)."}

taunting_stance.name: Taunting Stance
description: ::ab{icon=down-melee title="&L&Taunting Stance (Ex)&FN&" flavor="The barbarian can leave herself open to attacks while preparing devastating counterattacks." passive="Enemies gain a +4 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the barbarian while she's in this stance, but every attack against the barbarian provokes an attack of opportunity from her, which is resolved prior to each provoking attack." prereq="12th-level barbarian"}
